player_prompt.intro:
Kakanaan yo so {N} na angideng a value neng sekwenso.
Ed say anggad step, typen yo [accept] a angipen so *kasalanan* a value, o [continue] a ipalen yo et tan awiten so sun next.
No ag yo anggad inakuan, say forcesen yo a angipen so angideng a value.
Ag yo agew (reward = 1) **lamang** no say value a inyong pinili ay say pinakataas na amin.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Say action et nepeg ya [accept] odino [continue].

outcome.summary: Inyong inakuan so value {value} ed draw {draw_num}/{N}. Say pinakapangyarin ay {best}. {result}
